# OCG LAB

> OCG LAB builds practical AI systems, AI agents, business automation, custom software, SaaS tools, content systems, and digital products for businesses.

## Primary pages
- Home: https://www.theocglab.com/
- Custom AI systems and services: https://www.theocglab.com/services/
- OCG LAB Store: https://www.theocglab.com/store/
- AI Weekly / newsletter: https://www.theocglab.com/newsletter/

## Core capabilities
- Custom AI operating systems
- AI agents and digital workforce systems
- CRM and business-process automation
- Custom web applications and SaaS products
- AI content, media, and marketing systems
- AI strategy, implementation, and integration

## Store categories
- AI PRO and AI SUPER PRO
- Digital AI Playbooks
- Real-estate and business calculators
- Role-specific workflow tools

OCG LAB focuses on practical systems built around real workflows, with governed actions and verified outcomes.
